component-o.description-s: Nano-Fit right-angle header, single row, 2 circuits, 2.50 mm pitch, through hole with two PCB pegs, gold (0.76 um), 8.0 A per contact, 250 V, -40~115 C. Sits at the board edge (mating along +x). Battery link: 1 BAT+, 2 GND. Mates with 105307 / OTS harness 45130-02xx.

connector-o.board_area_note_s: courtyard plus the on-board part of the mate keepout (right-angle at the board edge: the mate overhangs the edge)

mate-o.frame_s: the board connector's footprint frame; the model is built there, so offset and rotation are zero
mate-o.source_s: Molex SD-105313-100 (header 10.38 long, 6.64 high, latch flush with the PCB edge as option 1), SD-105307-100 receptacle; at the board edge the mated plug overhangs the edge, so the board gives only the courtyard

connector-o.source_s: Molex SD-105313-100 (header 10.38 long, 6.64 high, latch flush with the PCB edge as option 1), SD-105307-100 receptacle; at the board edge the mated plug overhangs the edge, so the board gives only the courtyard
connector-o.current_note_s: 6.5 A per contact is the 45130 OTS harness rating at 20 AWG (Molex 45130-0203); the gold header alone is rated 8.0 A
